title: asplenium ceterach subsp. bivalens
intro: Asplenium ceterach subsp. bivalens, commonly known as the Two-lobed Rustyback, is a subspecies of fern belonging to the family Aspleniaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, which include treating fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions. The Two-lobed Rustyback is believed to have therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antipyretic properties, attributed to its bioactive constituents including flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids. However, more research is needed to confirm the specific health benefits and bioactive constituents of Asplenium ceterach subsp. bivalens.
